detailed.englishDescription: The content or structure of something being detailed and substantial.

event.definitionKo: 많은 사람들을 대상으로 여는 행사나 잔치.
event.englishDescription: An event or party held for many people.
An event that takes place unexpectedly or by accident.

start-up.definitionKo: 첨단의 신기술과 아이디어를 가지고 모험적인 경영을 하는 중소기업.
start-up.englishDescription: A small- and medium-sized company that is managed adventurously with state-of-the-art new technologies and ideas.

trombone.definitionKo: 'U'자 모양의 관 두 개를 맞추어 만든, 관을 뽑거나 당겨 음을 조절하는 금관 악기.
trombone.englishDescription: A brass instrument made by connecting two U-shaped pipes, whose sounds are adjusted by sliding or pulling one of the pipes.

unwittingly.englishExpression: in the manner of one being unaware of something; unwittingly
unwittingly.englishDescription: While one is unaware of something.

update.definitionKo: 이미 있는 정보를 최신 정보로 바꿈.
update.englishDescription: Replace existing information with the latest information.

zambia.definitionKo: 아프리카 중부에 있는 나라. 주요 생산물은 구리이다. 주요 언어는 영어이고 수도는 루사카이다.
zambia.englishDescription: A country in the middle of Africa; its major product is copper; its main language is English and its capital is Lusaka.
